metadata.title: The algorithm | The Real Best
metadata.description: Per-position weights, baselines and context multipliers of the Fair Player Index: the exact math behind every score.

title: The algorithm and the rules
subtitle: How the Fair Player Index turns every match into an auditable score. Every number on this page comes from the scoring engine currently in use.

error.title: Could not load the algorithm
error.description: The API did not respond. Please try again in a moment.

actions.title: 1. Match actions
actions.description: Each action has a different weight depending on the position. The position baseline is subtracted from the total, so an average performance is worth {base} in any role.

context.title: 2. Context
context.description: The action balance is multiplied by the tournament weight, the opponent's strength and how open the game still was.

season.title: 3. Season
season.description: Match scores become the Fair Season Score: a tournament-weighted average, adjusted for time on the pitch.

mps.title: Match Performance Score (MPS)
mps.equation: MPS = {base} + (Σ actions − baseline × minutes factor) × W_tournament × W_opponent × W_clutch
mps.clamp: The result is capped between {min} and {max}.
mps.volumeNote: Volume actions (tackles, passes, duels…) are also scaled by the minutes factor. One-off events such as goals and cards count in full: a goal by a player who came on in the 80th minute is still a whole goal.

weights.title: Weights by position
weights.description: Points each action adds (or removes) in each role. A dash means the action does not score in that position.
weights.caption: Weight matrix of algorithm v{version}
weights.baselineHint: Average balance of a full performance in the position, measured on the real data imported.
weights.noDataLegend: No data: the current source (API-Football) does not provide this statistic. The weight is in place but adds zero until another source is added.

multipliers.title: Context multipliers
multipliers.description: Applied only to the action balance, never to the base score. They multiply each other.

opponent.title: Opponent strength
opponent.description: Opponent's Elo rating on the match date (ClubElo).
opponent.unrated: No rating (national teams or source unavailable)

clutch.title: Clutch factor
clutch.description: Derived from the final score margin.
clutch.tight: Draw or decided by up to {max} goal

minutes.title: Minutes factor
minutes.cameo: Players with fewer than {min} minutes only count towards the season if they made a decisive action (goal, assist…).

fss.title: Fair Season Score (FSS)
fss.equation: FSS = (Σ MPS × W_tournament ÷ Σ W_tournament) × presence factor
fss.presence: Presence factor = √(min(1, minutes ÷ {minutes})). Players with little game time have their score smoothed.
fss.eligibility: To enter the ranking: at least {matches} matches and {minutes} minutes in the season.
fss.why: An average, not a sum: playing more matches does not inflate the score. What counts is the level of each performance.

audit.title: Check it yourself
audit.description: Every match of every player has a receipt with the full calculation, action by action.
